verdict.rationale: Letta offers some multi-item automation primitives — subagents for parallel task delegation ('divide and conquer tasks') and a cross-agent `/search` command that queries across all agents at once — which support limited bulk-style operations, but there is no documented bulk API for batch-creating, editing, importing/exporting, or mass-updating agents, memory blocks, or files. Missing for 10: explicit bulk CRUD/batch APIs, bulk import/export tooling, and evidence of large-scale multi-item operations beyond parallel subagent delegation and cross-agent search.
